extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research administrators preparing an NIH-style grant application (biosketch, research support, and Research & Related budget)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the 'Contributions to Science' biosketch entries, listing research support (ongoing/completed/other/pending), and completing the NIH Research & Related Budget forms (Sections A–K) for a project grant submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: A narrative section describing the applicant's substantive contributions to science (numbered items with focused topics such as 'Epidemiological synergy between HIV and other infections', 'Prevention and control of sexually transmitted infections', 'Epidemiology and microbial etiologies of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)', and 'Implementation and scale-up of phase-specific strategies for STI and HIV epidemics').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each contribution is expressed as a short thematic heading followed by a concise description of the research problem, the applicant’s role (e.g., 'I served as primary or co-investigator on each of these analyses'), the importance/impact (e.g., informed program design, contributed to CDC guidelines), and key supporting publications (lettered a., b., c., ...). Include joint first-author notes and PMCID/PMID when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete List of Published Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography with a URL (example: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/myncbi/…/bibliography/…/?sort=date&direction=ascending).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an accessible, sorted bibliography link to the applicant's publications to support the Contributions to Science narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support — Ongoing, Completed, and Other Support
rubrics_metrics.description: List current (Ongoing Research Support), Completed Research Support, and OTHER SUPPORT entries for the applicant and named personnel. Each entry shows award identifiers, PI names, project titles, project goals, dates, role (e.g., Role: Co-investigator, Role: Principal Investigator), and source (NIH, HRSA, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each support entry include start and end dates, dollar amounts where shown, a concise description of project goals, and the applicant's role. Mark ACTIVE/PENDING status clearly. Sub-award and subcontract relationships are noted when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project-Level Budget Type and Organizational Identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET header fields required: OMB Number; Expiration Date; ORGANIZATIONAL DUNS*; Budget Type* (● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium); Enter name of Organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget type must be selected correctly (Project vs Subaward/Consortium) and the organization's DUNS provided. These are mandatory administrative identifiers for the Research & Related budget forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Period and Project Dates
rubrics_metrics.description: For each budget period provide Start Date*, End Date*, and Budget Period number (e.g., Start Date: 09-01-2018 End Date: 08-31-2019 Budget Period: 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply accurate project period dates for each budget period in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section A — Senior/Key Person Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide for each Senior/Key Person: Prefix, First Name*, Middle, Last Name*, Suffix, Project Role* (e.g., PD/PI), Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($)*, Fringe Benefits ($)*, Funds Requested ($)*. Also 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file' and 'Total Senior/Key Person'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report effort in months, base salary, and requested salary for the budget period; compute totals for all Senior/Key Persons. Attach any file listing additional senior/key persons if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section B — Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: List number and budget details for Other Personnel roles (e.g., Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Programmer) including Project Role*, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($)*, Fringe Benefits*, Funds Requested ($)*, and 'Total Number Other Personnel'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categorize personnel by role and provide months of effort and compensation for each category; include fringe and subtotal the Other Personnel funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C — Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $ [threshold]. Provide 'Equipment Item' entries and 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file' and 'Total Equipment'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report individual equipment items above the applicable institutional threshold (form shows a threshold placeholder). Include funds requested and attach supporting documentation if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D — Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Funds Requested ($)* for travel broken down into '1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions)' and '2. Foreign Travel Costs'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel costs and include appropriate justification in the budget justification attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section E — Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Participant/Trainee support items: 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, 2. Stipends, 3. Travel, 4. Subsistence, 5. Other; include 'Number of Participants/Trainees' and 'Total Participant Trainee Support Costs'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List participant support separately (these costs are distinct from personnel costs) and indicate the count of trainees/participants and total costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section F — Other Direct Costs (detailed categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Direct Costs categories include: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; (and other numbered lines), plus line items shown in examples: Conference Calls, Airtime and Internet Data; Participant Costs & Uganda Subject Review; Course Fees, Books; Course Fees and Registration; Ugandan Human Subjects Review and Participant Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item amounts for each Other Direct Cost category used by the project; include subaward/subcontract details where applicable and include descriptive labels (e.g., 'Participant Costs & Uganda Subject Review').

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections G, H, I, J, K — Totals, Indirect Costs, and Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs; H. Indirect Costs including 'Indirect Cost Type' (e.g., MTDC), 'Indirect Cost Rate (%)', 'Indirect Cost Base ($)', 'Funds Requested ($)*', and 'Cognizant Federal Agency' contact; I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs; J. Fee; K. Total Costs and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and report direct cost totals, indirects using the institution's negotiated rate (specify base and rate), include cognizant agency contact, and calculate total project costs and any fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section L — Budget Justification and Attachment Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach 'L. Budget Justification*' as a file (file name and mime type required). Note: '(Only attach one file.)' and examples show FINAL_BudgJust_ModelingTB3_20180501.pdf and Mime Type: application/pdf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a single, consolidated budget justification file explaining the requested costs; follow the 'only one file' rule and use an acceptable mime type (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Tracking and Funding Opportunity Metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields to include tracking and administrative metadata: 'Tracking Number: GRANT12621699', 'Funding Opportunity Number: PA-18-369', 'Received Date: 2018-05-04T16:42:25.000-04:00', and related per-period tracking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure tracking numbers and funding opportunity identifiers are included and accurate for submission records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting and Mandatory Field Indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields marked with '*' (e.g., First Name*, Project Role*, Funds Requested ($)*) are mandatory. Checkbox indicators (e.g., ● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium) denote mutually exclusive choices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all required fields marked with an asterisk and correctly select checkboxes for required categorical items.
